definitions.explanation: A state of being hard to accomplish or deal with.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
{生活|せいかつ}が{困難|こんなん}になった。
{困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}に{直面|ちょくめん}している。
examples.english: We are facing a difficult situation.

notes:
{困難|こんなん} means difficulty or hardship, and can also function as a na-adjective.

GRAMMAR:
- As noun: {困難|こんなん}に{直面|ちょくめん}する (to face difficulties)
- As na-adjective: {困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう} (a difficult situation)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to overcome difficulties
- {困難|こんなん}に{直面|ちょくめん}する: to face difficulties
- {困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}: difficult situation
- {困難|こんなん}を{極|きわ}める: to be extremely difficult

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難|むずか}しい: difficult (casual, general)
- {困難|こんなん}: difficulty (formal, often serious challenges)
- {苦難|くなん}: hardship, suffering
- {難関|なんかん}: barrier, difficult challenge
